title: agg answer result, schema_version 1
description: `agg answer <id> <value> --json`. Exit 0 when accepted, 1 when refused (unknown id, already answered, a value off a bool/choose ask's options). An accepted answer reaches the worker's next brief, or the driver blocked on it.

reason.description: why it was refused; null when accepted

answer.description: the answer as recorded (an option number resolved to its text); null when refused
